notes: v1.14.546 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 6.2: THE HW REF MATRIX IS DECOUPLED. The matrix markup (search, model and category filters, count, list) is now AUTHORED inside #rf-hwref instead of being moved there at boot from the #hw-matrix-sheet modal. redesign_homeHWRef and its registration are deleted — the second of eight re-homes — and the sheet goes with them, along with its CSS rule, its selector in the shared sheet-blur rule, and hwMatrix_close() whose only caller was the CLOSE button in the header the re-home used to strip. Every id is verbatim (#hwm-search, #hwm-count, #hwm-list, the model/category stabs) because hwMatrix_render and its filters resolve them with getElementById: identity is the contract, not position. ⭐ The markup was MOVED programmatically rather than retyped, so the 20 lines are byte-identical to what shipped before. ⚠ The re-home did one thing markup cannot — it called hwMatrix_render() after moving, so the tab painted populated on first open; that call now lives in hwMatrix_open()'s single path. ⛔ VISIBLE UNDER ?legacy=1: the legacy house LOSES the HW Ref matrix. #rf-hwref sits inside pg-ref, which legacy never shows, so routing there would be a dead render reporting success — hwMatrix_open() says so with a toast instead. The legacy NOW-dashboard HW Ref tile is deliberately LEFT: it now explains rather than failing silently, which is Contract 14 compliant, and removing more legacy chrome is churn this ship does not need.
